name: Tipi
source:
The "Blue Little Lady" from the library. She lives in the town's library. For some reason, she is often found crying.

In the age of digital books, this strangeplace for storing physical copies still exists. 

Shiona calls her "Blue Girl".

"Hey, Rei, what book are you looking for today?"

[From the [url=http://key.visualarts.gr.jp/harmonia/]official website[/url]]
